title: flow reviewer output
description: Every reviewer (and the browser-tester) returns exactly one object in this format, inside a ```json block. Validated by scripts/review.mjs validate. Prose fields (summary, category, evidence, fix, builderNote) are written in the run language (flow.json.language).

summary.description: One sentence on the state of the slice.

findings.description: Empty when there are no concrete findings.

id.description: Reviewer prefix + number: SEC-001, UX-001, UI-001, CODE-001, BRW-001. In round 2, a re-evaluated finding keeps its round-1 id.

category.description: E.g. "A01 Broken Access Control", "WCAG 2.4.7 Focus Visible", "Missing test".

file.description: Path relative to the repository root, with /.

line.description: Line in the new file. null only for findings without a line (e.g. whole file, on-screen behavior).

evidence.description: What was observed, concrete and verifiable.

contested.description: Round 2: true when the builder disputed the finding and the reviewer keeps it.

builderNote.description: Round 2: the reason the builder gave when disputing, or the commit it gave when reporting a fix.

unverified.description: Set by review.mjs carry, never by a reviewer: the builder reported it fixed and no reviewer has re-checked it yet.

artifacts.description: browser-tester only: screenshots and reports it produced.
